title: Elastography in Superficial Lymphadenopathy
brief_summary: Evaluation of the role of Ultrasound Elastography in differentiation between benign and malignant lymph nodes and its additional information over the classic gray scale and color Doppler ultrasound.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Patients presented with enlarged lymph nodes by clinical examination.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who previously receive any medical treatment or chemo or radiotherapy.
* Patients who previously underwent fine needle aspiration cytology or biopsy.
